correctness.rationale: For strictly ordered x_i with gaps in [c/2,c), only adjacent vertices have distance <c. Substituting the source sign-repulsion targets yields endpoint means (x_1+x_2−c)/2 and (x_{n−1}+c+x_n)/2, with interior triple averages. Offsets e_i=x_i−(i−1)c follow a stochastic lazy path P, consecutive deficit differences δ_i=e_i−e_{i+1} follow symmetric nonnegative tridiagonal Q with endpoints diag 1/6, interiors/off-diagonals 1/3. Positive δ<=c/2 is invariant since Q nonnegative and substochastic with endpoint leakage, so the path remains receptive at every finite step. Primitive Perron and reversibility with weights d_1=d_n=2/d_interior=3 give convergence to μ+(i−1)c, where strict confidence excludes all edges. The Toeplitz Rayleigh bound gives rho bracket and 1−rho=pi²/(3n²)+O(n^-3). Independent exact-Fraction state updates corroborated 216 transitions (n=3..10, three different initial deficit profiles, nine rounds) and symmetric eigenvalue computation confirmed brackets for n=3..30. Universality is from matrix theory/induction, not finite tests.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification only tests bounded instances; universal portions follow from reconstructed analytic proof.

value.rationale: In dynamically changing confidence graphs, convergence of states need not entail eventual stabilization of receptive links. The explicit open invariant chamber supplies permanent finite-time connectivity with an edgeless limiting graph and a sharp diffusion-like relaxation rate for arbitrary population size; this directly sharpens interpretation of the original repulsive model rather than merely reporting one numerical orbit.

final_claim: An open full-dimensional chamber of ordered opinions in the all-repulsive discrete bounded-confidence update keeps an exactly receptive path for every finite time even though its limit is the nonreceptive c-spaced lattice; the deficit follows an explicit tridiagonal primitive matrix with 1−rho_n~pi²/(3n²) and complete-confidence examples for three/four agents.
limitations: Only strictly ordered open chamber of complete uniformly repulsive networks, synchronized updates and strict confidence cutoff.
